scripts.check: pnpm run check:roadmap && pnpm run check:web && pnpm run check:rust
scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace --locked
scripts.check:web: pnpm -r run typecheck && pnpm -r run lint && pnpm -r run test
scripts.e2e: pnpm run build:app && pnpm --filter @folio/e2e run e2e
